r1_risk_change: 2024 against 2019: each outcome under the denominators it can be paired with
l2_observed_over_trend: Observed deaths as a share of the pre-pandemic trend, 2010–2024
l1_trend_projection: Road deaths against the pre-pandemic trend, under three measures
l4_km_against_fuel: Interurban deaths against the pre-pandemic trend: per measured kilometre, and over national road fuel as a check
l3_frequency_severity: Deaths per tonne of road fuel, split two ways into how often and how deadly (1996 = 100)
m1_season_profile: Deaths and three measures of road use by month (average month = 100)
m2_month_effects: Deaths by month against the average month, raw and per tonne of road fuel
m3_lockdown: 2020 against the same month of 2017–2019: deaths and traffic
a3_sex_ratios: Men against women, private-car drivers: crashing, and dying (2022–2024)
f1_speed_severity: Deaths per crash when speed is recorded, against other crashes
f2_factor_shares: Share of injury crashes with each factor recorded; gaps are breaks in comparability
c3_speed_status: Drivers in injury crashes by recorded speed status, all roads
s1_forest_fatal: Odds of at least one death, by crash circumstance
s2_adverse_conditions: Adverse conditions and a fatal outcome: the same odds ratio under 8 models
dr1_involved_per_km: Car drivers involved in injury crashes per kilometre driven, against drivers aged 45–64 (2024)
dr2_killed_per_involved: Car drivers killed per 1,000 involved in an injury crash, by age (2024)
v1_per_vehicle_vs_per_km: Vehicles in fatal crashes: the ranking per vehicle and per kilometre, 2022
p1_points_series: Monthly road deaths around the points-based licence, 2000–2007
p2_july_placebos: The July break estimated at every July the licence cannot explain
d1_missingness: Share of crashes with a value recorded, by field and year
cat2_fatal_by_speed_limit: Fatal share by posted speed limit (the road's limit, not vehicle speed)
cat3_fatal_by_unit: Fatal share by type of road user or vehicle involved (a crash can involve several)
cat6_crashes_by_year: Crashes with a death or serious injury, by year
bcn1_severity_by_road_user: Serious or fatal injury by road user (role and vehicle type on the record)
bcn2_severity_by_age: Serious or fatal injury by age band
bcn4_crash_severity_by_type: Crashes with a serious or fatal injury, by crash type
ml1_test_auc: Test ROC-AUC: each model against its descriptive table and the baseline
ml2_calibration: Calibration on the test records: observed share against predicted probability
ml3_importance_catalonia_crash_severity: Catalonia crash-severity model: the variables it relies on most
ml3_importance_barcelona_person_severity: Barcelona person-severity model: the variables it relies on most
tr1_catalonia_transfer: Catalonia crash-severity model on held-out places and years
tr2_dgt_transfer: Harmonised Catalonia model on other sources, years and Spain
tr3_province_auc: Harmonised Catalonia model, province by province outside Catalonia
sev1_predicted_observed: Predicted and observed: the share of severe crashes that were fatal
